items.body:
##### SUMMARY
Various valid git branches cannot be checked out by the git module.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
git

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
```
ansible 2.9.2
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/notting/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/lib/python3.7/site-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.7.5 (default, Oct 17 2019, 12:16:48) [GCC 9.2.1 20190827 (Red Hat 9.2.1-1)]
```

##### CONFIGURATION
```
ANSIBLE_PIPELINING(/etc/ansible/ansible.cfg) = True
DEFAULT_LOG_PATH(/etc/ansible/ansible.cfg) = /tmp/ansible.log
HOST_KEY_CHECKING(/etc/ansible/ansible.cfg) = False
PERSISTENT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT(/etc/ansible/ansible.cfg) = 30
RETRY_FILES_ENABLED(/etc/ansible/ansible.cfg) = False
```

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT
Fedora 31, git-2.24.1


##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE

```
---
- hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: False

  vars:
    branches:
      - '""'
      - '$PATH'
      - hawai'i
      - ' whitespace-the-final-frontier'

  tasks:
    - name: it's git clobberin' time...
      git:
         repo: "https://github.com/wenottingham/testbranch.git"
         dest: "/tmp/funtimes"
         version: "{{ item }}"
         force: yes
         depth: 1
      loop: "{{ branches }}"
      ignore_errors: True
      delegate_to: localhost
```

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
All successful.

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
None successful.
```
failed: [localhost -> localhost] (item="") => {"ansible_facts": {"discovered_interpreter_python": "/usr/bin/python"}, "ansible_loop_var": "item", "changed": false, "cmd": "/usr/bin/git checkout --force \"\"", "item": "\"\"", "msg": "Failed to checkout \"\"", "rc": 128, "stderr": "fatal: empty string is not a valid pathspec. please use . instead if you meant to match all paths\n", "stderr_lines": ["fatal: empty string is not a valid pathspec. please use . instead if you meant to match all paths"], "stdout": "", "stdout_lines": []}

failed: [localhost -> localhost] (item=$PATH) => {"ansible_loop_var": "item", "changed": false, "cmd": "/usr/bin/git checkout --force $PATH", "item": "$PATH", "msg": "Failed to checkout $PATH", "rc": 128, "stderr": "fatal: Invalid path '<some component of my actual path>:': No such file or directory\n", "stderr_lines": ["fatal: Invalid path '<some component of my actual path>:': No such file or directory"], "stdout": "", "stdout_lines": []}

An exception occurred during task execution. To see the full traceback, use -vvv. The error was: ValueError: No closing quotation
failed: [localhost -> localhost] (item=hawai'i) => {"ansible_loop_var": "item", "changed": false, "item": "hawai'i", "module_stderr": "Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"<stdin>\", line 102, in <module>\n  File \"<stdin>\", line 94, in _ansiballz_main\n  File \"<stdin>\", line 40, in invoke_module\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/runpy.py\", line 205, in run_module\n    return _run_module_code(code, init_globals, run_name, mod_spec)\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/runpy.py\", line 96, in _run_module_code\n    mod_name, mod_spec, pkg_name, script_name)\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/runpy.py\", line 85, in _run_code\n    exec(code, run_globals)\n  File \"/tmp/ansible_git_payload_5sddcen7/ansible_git_payload.zip/ansible/modules/source_control/git.py\", line 1269, in <module>\n  File \"/tmp/ansible_git_payload_5sddcen7/ansible_git_payload.zip/ansible/modules/source_control/git.py\", line 1223, in main\n  File \"/tmp/ansible_git_payload_5sddcen7/ansible_git_payload.zip/ansible/modules/source_control/git.py\", line 764, in fetch\n  File \"/tmp/ansible_git_payload_5sddcen7/ansible_git_payload.zip/ansible/modules/source_control/git.py\", line 640, in is_remote_branch\n  File \"/tmp/ansible_git_payload_5sddcen7/ansible_git_payload.zip/ansible/module_utils/basic.py\", line 2502, in run_command\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/shlex.py\", line 309, in split\n    return list(lex)\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/shlex.py\", line 299, in __next__\n    token = self.get_token()\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/shlex.py\", line 109, in get_token\n    raw = self.read_token()\n  File \"/usr/lib64/python3.7/shlex.py\", line 191, in read_token\n    raise ValueError(\"No closing quotation\")\nValueError: No closing quotation\n", "module_stdout": "", "msg": "MODULE FAILURE\nSee stdout/stderr for the exact error", "rc": 1}
```
